validity.recommendation: Treat as GEM-only / unverified entity. Find a primary, non-OPEC-aggregate source that NAMES an Abqaiq<->Berri gas line with these specs before keeping; if none, consider demotion/merge. Also re-examine commodity (see classification note).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE is the central problem. The gem.wiki page cites only two sources: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012 (p.75) and OPEC ASB 2017 (p.136). The OPEC ASB does NOT enumerate individual named pipelines -- it carries country-level AGGREGATE oil/gas pipeline-network length tables. So the cited references cannot support the existence of a specific named 'Abqaiq-Berri gas pipeline' nor its 137 km / 24,36-in / operating specifics; at best they support that Saudi Arabia has a gas pipeline network of some total length. Independent searches (English, plus Aramco/SPA/Argaam-style sources) for 'Abqaiq-Berri' / 'Abqaiq to Berri' gas pipeline returned NO independent hit -- every result either traces back to GEM or is about unrelated lines (Abqaiq-Yanbu NGL, East-West crude, Abu Ali-Berri, UBTG lines, Berri downstream). No EPC award, no trade-press mention, no operator document names this pipeline. CLASSIFICATION overlap worth flagging: real Aramco infrastructure around these two nodes is dominated by NGL, not dry-gas transmission -- Berri Gas Plant recovers ~800 kbd of NGL and Abqaiq hosts major NGL fractionation facilities, so a physical Berri<->Abqaiq link is more plausibly an NGL/feeder line than a dry-gas trunk; the dual 24/36-in diameter is also more consistent with a field/feeder line than a single transmission trunk. CONCLUSION: independent confirmation of this exact named pipeline could not be found; the only traces are GEM-derived or OPEC aggregates. Flagging existence (possible mis-attributed/aggregate-derived or hallucinated entity), with a secondary classification doubt (possible NGL line recorded as gas). Saudi Aramco ownership and that Berri is a gas plant in the Eastern Province are independently true (Saudipedia, OGJ) but those sources do not name this pipeline.

summary: P1906 Abqaiq-Berri gas pipeline: EXISTENCE concern -- only sources are OPEC ASB country-aggregate tables (not named-pipeline data) and GEM echoes; no independent source names this 137 km/24,36-in line; secondary classification doubt (likely NGL, not dry gas). No refs could be honestly staged for its specs.
